more_info.overview: Edible bone phosphate is a mixture of calcium phosphates containing mainly tribasic calcium phosphate. JECFA describes the material as a heterogeneous residual preparation, so it should not be equated with every purified calcium-phosphate salt. Its listed functions include emulsifying, retaining moisture and binding metal ions. The historical entry describes the bone-phosphate preparation specifically, while related phosphates have separate identities.
